name: autoloan-nextjs-nestjs
description: Auto Loan App - Next.js + NestJS TypeScript Full-Stack Monorepo

scripts.dev: npm run dev:backend & npm run dev:frontend
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage:backend && npm run test:coverage:frontend
scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/backend && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:seed: cd apps/backend && npx prisma db seed
